drafts.rationale: EV-O-A01 and EV-O-A02 bound each job to at most three executions in total, with the first counting toward that limit and no further attempt after the third ends without success.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B01 and EV-O-B02 require a fixed five-second wait from the end of a failed attempt before every retry, independent of attempt number.
drafts.subject: Orion job retry

drafts.rationale: EV-O-C01 and EV-O-C02 bound each attempt to thirty seconds / half a minute and treat an attempt that reaches that limit as failed.
drafts.subject: Orion execution attempt

drafts.rationale: EV-O-D01 and EV-O-D02 require ignoring further deliveries of an active job id without changing the active job's state.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E01 and EV-O-E02 require retaining each idempotency key for twenty-four hours after first seen, after which it may be forgotten.
drafts.subject: Orion idempotency key

drafts.rationale: EV-O-F01 and EV-O-F02 set the worker lease to sixty seconds from delivery and make the job available to other workers if it expires without renewal or release.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: EV-O-G01 and EV-O-G02 allow renewal every thirty seconds while work progresses and require each renewal to extend the lease by the full lease duration from the renewal moment.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H01 and EV-O-H02 forbid starting further attempts after cancellation while requiring an already running attempt to run to completion, failure, or timeout.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I01 and EV-O-I02 require automatically moving a job to the dead-letter queue after its final unsuccessful attempt and not executing it again unless explicitly resubmitted.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J01 and EV-O-J02 require an operator escalation when three dead-letter events occur for the same tenant within one hour measured from the first event.
drafts.subject: Orion operator escalation

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K01 and EV-O-K02 guarantee first-in-first-out execution only among jobs in the same queue partition and make no ordering guarantee across partitions.
drafts.subject: Orion queue partition

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L01 and EV-O-L02 require retaining audit events for thirty days after they are recorded and allow deletion thereafter.
drafts.subject: Orion audit event

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A02 and EV-O-A01 require that a job be executed at most three times in total, counting the first execution, with no further execution started after a third unsuccessful attempt.
EV-O-B02 and EV-O-B01 require a wait of exactly five seconds from the end of a failed attempt before every retry, and forbid changing that wait based on attempt number.
EV-O-C01 requires a thirty-second timeout recorded as failure; EV-O-C02 restates the same half-minute limit and requires the execution to be stopped and recorded as a failed attempt.
EV-O-D02 and EV-O-D01 require duplicate deliveries of an active job id to be ignored without changing the state of the active job.

value.text: While a job with a given job id is active, further deliveries carrying that job id must be ignored and must not change the active job's state.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E02 and EV-O-E01 require each idempotency key to be retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen, after which a later delivery with the same key is treated as new.
EV-O-F02 and EV-O-F01 require a worker lease to last sixty seconds from delivery; when it expires without renewal or release the job becomes available to other workers.
EV-O-G02 and EV-O-G01 allow renewal every thirty seconds while work is progressing and require a renewal to extend the lease by the full lease duration from the renewal moment.

value.text: A worker may renew its lease every thirty seconds while work is progressing; each renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H02 and EV-O-H01 forbid starting further attempts after cancellation while requiring an in-flight attempt to run to completion, failure, or timeout.

value.text: After cancellation, no future execution attempt may be started, but an already running attempt is not interrupted and runs to its own completion, failure, or timeout.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I02 and EV-O-I01 require an automatic move to the dead-letter queue after the final unsuccessful attempt, with no further execution unless the job is explicitly resubmitted.

value.text: After the final unsuccessful execution attempt, the job is automatically moved to the dead-letter queue and must not be executed again unless explicitly resubmitted.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J02 and EV-O-J01 require an operator escalation when three dead-letter events occur for the same tenant within one hour measured from the first event.

value.text: Three dead-letter events for the same tenant within one hour, measured from the first of the three events, raise an operator escalation.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K02 and EV-O-K01 guarantee first-in-first-out execution only among jobs in the same queue partition and make no ordering guarantee across partitions.

value.text: FIFO execution order is guaranteed only among jobs in the same queue partition; no ordering guarantee is made between jobs in different partitions.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L02 and EV-O-L01 require audit events to be retained for thirty days after they are recorded, after which an audit event may be deleted.
